page.description: What the AI in your flows can do beyond talking: look up a postal code, book a slot, take a note about a customer. Install what makes sense, without writing code.
page.installedHint: One step left: each AI block in a flow says what it can use.
page.allInstalled: You've installed everything in the catalog.
page.emptyDescription: No tools are available yet. If you code, you can create a function in the Functions tab.
page.noResultsDescription: Try another word, or clear the filters.

panel.uninstallDescription: This tool's functions leave the organization, and the blocks that use them stop finding them. The ones you personalized stay.
panel.enabledHint: When off, the functions don't run and blocks don't offer them. Nothing is lost: just turn it back on.
panel.turnedOff: {{name}} is off: the AI stops using these functions
panel.howToTitle: One step left: choose it in the flow
panel.howToDescription: Installing doesn't switch anything on by itself: each block chooses what it uses. In the flow, open the "Chat with AI" block and tick this tool's functions, or use one of them in the "Run function" block.
panel.functionsHint: The AI picks which one to use, based on the conversation.
panel.reversible: You can uninstall it whenever you want.

credentials.title: Access keys
credentials.hint: The outside service asks for this. It's stored encrypted, and doesn't show again once saved.
credentials.hintKeep: Already stored, encrypted. Fill in only what you want to change: anything left blank stays as it is.

codeGate.title: Writing code needs a bigger screen
codeGate.description: To take your time, open this on a computer. To fix one line right now, you can open it here anyway.

functions.description: The functions flow blocks can use: the ones that came with tools and the ones you write in JavaScript.
functions.deleteDescription: Blocks that use this function stop finding it, and this can't be undone.
functions.emptyDescription: Install a tool from the catalog, or write your own in JavaScript.
functions.noResultsDescription: Try another word, or clear the filters.

personalize.title: Personalize {{name}}?
personalize.description: The code shows up and becomes editable, and the function stays even if you uninstall {{tool}}. In exchange, it stops getting the tool's updates.
personalize.descriptionWithKeys: The code shows up and becomes editable, and the function stays even if you uninstall {{tool}}. In exchange, it stops getting the tool's updates, and the access keys stored there no longer reach it.
personalize.done: {{name}} is yours now: the code is unlocked

parameters.empty: No parameters. A function without parameters works too: it just doesn't receive anything from its caller.
parameters.name: Name
parameters.nameHint: No spaces. In the code, it's params.{{name}}.
parameters.descriptionHint: This is what the AI reads to know what to send here.
parameters.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: the delivery postal code, digits only
parameters.enumHint: Leave blank to accept any text.
parameters.importDescription: Paste the JSON in the AI models' tool format, or a list of parameters.
parameters.importReplaceOn: The current parameters go away, and only the JSON's stay.
parameters.importReplaceOff: The JSON's are added to the current ones. Repeated names are ignored.

importErrors.invalidJson: That isn't valid JSON. Check the quotes and commas.
importErrors.unknownFormat: Unknown format. Use an object with "properties", or a list.
importErrors.duplicates: All of these parameters already exist: nothing to add.

tester.failed: Couldn't run the test. Try again.
tester.noParameters: This function doesn't receive anything: just run it.
tester.invalidValue: This value doesn't match the parameter's type.
tester.invalidJsonValue: Write it in JSON, with quotes around text.
tester.jsonLabel: What the function receives, in JSON
tester.jsonInvalid: It must be a valid JSON object, like { "zip": "80010000" }.
tester.chatHint: Optional. Some functions need a contact: without a conversation, they fail in the test.

editor.fixErrors: Fix what's marked before saving and testing.
editor.name: Name
editor.nameHint: It's how the AI calls the function. No spaces or accents.
editor.descriptionHint: The clearer it is, the better the AI decides when to use it.
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Calculates shipping cost and delivery time for a postal code. Use it when the customer asks how much it costs or when it arrives.
editor.parametersHint: Each parameter becomes params.name in the code, and the AI fills it in from the conversation.
editor.codeHint: JavaScript. The caller sends data in params, and whatever you return goes back to the caller.
editor.testHint: The values are stored with the function, for the next test. Testing saves first: what runs is what's saved.
editor.testHintLocked: Run it with real values to see what it returns. Nothing here changes the function.
editor.lockedDescription: The tool takes care of the code, which gets improvements on its own. To see or change the code, personalize it.
editor.parametersHintLocked: The AI fills these in from the conversation.
editor.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted, or gone along with its tool.

errors.name: Give the function a name.
errors.nameInvalid: Use only letters, numbers and _, up to 64 characters.
errors.nameTaken: There's already a function with this name. The AI wouldn't know which one to use.
errors.description: Say what it does: that's what the AI reads to decide.
errors.parameterNameTaken: There's already a parameter with this name here.
errors.parameterDescription: Say what goes here: that's what the AI reads.

editor.lockedTitleUnknown: This function came from a tool

appointments.name: Appointments
appointments.description: Shows your services, finds open slots, and books or cancels appointments on your calendar.

atendimento-humano.name: Human support
atendimento-humano.description: Hands the conversation to someone on the team or a department, and picks it back up when it's time.

dynamic-database.name: Data tables
dynamic-database.description: Stores and looks up information in tables of its own, created on the fly, with nothing to set up first.

catalog.name: Product catalog
catalog.description: Finds products, properties or services in your catalog from what the customer describes, and suggests similar options.

contact-memory.name: Contact memory
contact-memory.description: Takes note of what matters about each contact, and remembers it in the next conversation.

pipelines.name: Pipelines
pipelines.description: Puts the contact in a pipeline, moves them along, fills in the card and closes the sale as won or lost.

contact-tags.name: Contact tags
contact-tags.description: Adds, removes and checks each contact's tags, to tell people apart.

utilidades-brasil.name: Brazil utilities
utilidades-brasil.description: Checks CPF and CNPJ numbers, finds an address from a postal code, works out age and tidies up phone numbers.

functionCopy.validate_cpf_cnpj: Checks whether a CPF or CNPJ is valid
functionCopy.lookup_cep: Finds an address from a postal code
functionCopy.calculate_age: Works out age from a birth date
functionCopy.list_services: Shows the services that can be booked
functionCopy.transfer_to_human_by_email: Hands the conversation to someone on the team
functionCopy.transfer_to_department: Hands the conversation to a department
functionCopy.resume_bot: Goes back to answering the conversation
functionCopy.assigned_agent: Says who's looking after the conversation
functionCopy.db_create_record: Stores a record in a table
functionCopy.db_find_records: Looks up records in a table
functionCopy.db_count_records: Counts the records in a table
functionCopy.catalog_search: Finds products from what the customer describes
functionCopy.catalog_facet_values: Shows the available options, like colors and sizes
functionCopy.remember_fact: Takes a note about the contact
functionCopy.set_contact_attribute: Fills in a detail on the contact's record
functionCopy.get_contact_attribute: Reads a detail from the contact's record
functionCopy.list_pipelines: Shows the pipelines and their stages
functionCopy.get_lead_pipeline_context: Says which stage the contact is in
functionCopy.qualify_lead_in_pipeline: Puts the contact in a pipeline
functionCopy.advance_lead_in_pipeline: Moves the contact to the next stage
functionCopy.add_label_to_lead: Adds a label to the card
functionCopy.set_lead_custom_field: Fills in a field on the card
functionCopy.comment_on_lead_card: Leaves a comment on the card
functionCopy.add_checklist_to_lead_card: Creates a to-do list on the card
functionCopy.add_contact_tag: Adds a tag to the contact
functionCopy.remove_contact_tag: Removes a tag from the contact
